notes: Registration input, not a run input: the market benchmark's daily bars, pulled exactly as the stock universe's (source-stock-daily.json: same transform, same split-adjusted basis, same <t>/underlying_prices.parquet layout) but from its own entity list, configs/benchmark_universe.json, so the benchmark never enters the study universe. Why a separate source: the archive's SPY series (philippdubach-options) ends 2025-12-12 while the stock bars run to the as_of date, so market-relative features would be null for the last months. No cache_dir: a fresh pull over the network (0.6 s throttle). Register: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source benchmark-daily-bars --catalog-source benchmark-daily-bars --connector httpblobs --config @configs/source-benchmark-daily.json --activate --root <store root>; then acquire --source benchmark-daily-bars --stream files --mode backfill.
